name: filter.withOwn
title: Field: filter.withOwn
description: Meaning of the buyer query filter.withOwn field.
text:
# filter.withOwn

TL;DR:
- filter.withOwn controls whether the collection may include the current user's own listings.

What it means:
- True allows the current user's own listings to remain in the result set.
- False excludes them.

Agent hint:
- Use filter.my when you want only the user's own listings. Use filter.withOwn when you want to control inclusion in a broader query.
